text:
ops-bot: ALERT: Multiple region-level heartbeats missing for eu-west7. Detected: control-plane + api-gateway flaps. severity=high :rotating_light:
marie (oncall): seeing a spike in 5xxs from customers in EU. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/eu-west7 latency+errors up 86%
sanjay (infra): I can still ssh to a few GPU nodes in eu-west7 but kube-apiserver is unresponsive. Nodes show Ready on node-agent but kubelet reports: 'connection refused'
evans (sre): @sanjay can you run kubelet logs + controller-manager? also check etcd leader health
sanjay (infra): running quick checks:
```
# kubectl --context=eu-west7 get pods -n redwood-system
Error from server (unable to connect)
# ssh node-12
$ journalctl -u kubelet | tail -n 20
Aug 12 10:12:34 kubelet[1234]: E0812 10:12:34.123 controller.go:456] failed to list pods: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
```
evan (sre): that points to controlplane network partition, not node kernel panic. could be controlplane VPC ENI flaps or virtual router instability
lee (network): confirming — cloud provider shows a regional control plane fabric flap for eu-west7, BGP channels resetting in 3 AZs. Provider-notice: "Investigating regional mesh instability". I've opened a ticket: https://cloud.srv/ticket/78910
marie (oncall): runbook step 1: confirm impact, runbook step 2: execute traffic shift policy to eu-west4/ eu-central1 if safe. Can someone sanity-check model compatibility for failover?
kelly (support): customers reporting API timeouts for embeddings and chat. Posting to status.redwood.io?
evan (sre): set status to partial outage for eu-west7, mention degraded inference and controlplane unavailability. I'll start failover checks.
sanjay (infra): quick check: GPU nodes still serving traffic at edge (request path: edge -> model-proxy -> node). But controller can't scale or reschedule. If we shift edge routing away, existing long-lived streams might break.
lee (network): recommend gradual traffic siphon: use smart-routing weight 30%->0 over 20m to avoid client disconnects. Also enable fallback to smaller-quantized model in target region to preserve latency.
evan (sre): running dry-run of routing change now: updating traffic policy in canary group to route to eu-central1 at 10%
ops-bot: ACTION_LOG: evan initiated traffic-shift dry-run at 3051234700.
marie (oncall): followup: autoscaler not able to provision new instances in region because cloud API returns 429 rate-limited on the control plane endpoints. That explains lack of new nodes even if provider recovers
sanjay (infra): workaround: start provisioning in eu-central1 and eu-west4 with preemptible/GPU spot pools, attach model snapshots from s3-replica. Will need to ensure KV cache warm-up to avoid cold-start penalties
kelly (support): I'll draft a short status update: "We are aware of elevated errors and degraded performance in eu-west7; traffic being shifted to nearby regions while we investigate. No customer data loss reported." Want approval before posting
marie (oncall): approve. Add note: engineering is investigating control-plane fabric with cloud provider. Post ETA: initial mitigation in progress
lee (network): provider status updated: engineering investigating BGP session reconnection; ETA unknown. We should prepare contact with provider on-call if they hit 30min mark
evan (sre): checklist for next 30m:
- continue slow traffic siphon -> eu-central1/eu-west4
- provision spot GPU pools in eu-central1 (sanjay)
- monitor in-flight streams for disconnects (marie)
- escalate to cloud on-call at 30m if control-plane still flapping (lee)
- post status updates every 15m (kelly)
sanjay (infra): provisioning started: launching 8 p4d-like preemptible nodes in eu-central1, snapshot restore started. ETA ~12m for instances to register
ops-bot: NOTE: rollback policy set to auto-revert if 5xx > 10% on target region for 5m
marie (oncall): pinging execs via 1:1 just to make them aware. Also creating incident ticket IR-2026-3051
cloud-srv-bot: Cloud provider ticket 78910 updated: "We are throttling control-plane traffic during mitigation. We're prioritizing control-plane recovery."
evan (sre): one more item — check Dedicated pools for impacted customer SLA tiers; some dedicated pools span eu-west7 exclusively. We need to engage account teams for those customers and offer temporary capacity in other regions
kelly (support): contacting AEs for Tier-1 dedicated customers now, putting recommended migration playbook in the thread
marie (oncall): current status: mitigation in progress, traffic siphon at 35% to eu-central1, preempt nodes booting. Monitoring errors and latencies. Next update in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
